attempted_claim: Let Gamma be countable discrete, i.c.c., nonamenable, non-properly-proximal, weakly amenable with Cowling-Haagerup constant Lambda_cb(Gamma)=1, and let Gamma acting on (X^Gamma, mu^Gamma)=:(X,mu) be the Bernoulli action with diffuse standard base. If Lambda acting on (Y,nu) is any free ergodic p.m.p. action and L^infty(X) semidirect Gamma is isomorphic to L^infty(Y) semidirect Lambda as von Neumann algebras, are L^infty(X) and L^infty(Y) unitarily conjugate in the ambient factor?
decisive_failure: The investigation could not bridge the gap between CMAP-level approximation from Cowling-Haagerup constant 1 and the boundary-rigidity control that proper proximality or biexactness supplies in all known Cartan-uniqueness proofs. No concrete group could be locally certified to satisfy all four simultaneous hypotheses, so neither a proof, a counterexample, nor a vacuity argument was completable with available tools.
